entries.text: Assistant chat can show the current action and an expandable activity trail, with a setting to turn execution progress off.
The Assistant can use conversation context to resolve a follow-up choice, and direct edit mode can apply a validated replacement without a separate intent check.
Fact Check cards now have controls to move to the previous or next finding.
Revision descriptions better identify editorial changes, with neutral wording instead of character-count fallbacks when a description cannot be generated.
Archived Articles are anchored at the bottom of library navigation, and footer controls align across expanded and collapsed navigation.
The desktop editor menu now places link editing after the Formatting menu.
A dedicated Fact Check guide explains verdicts, sources, finding decisions, corrections, and rechecking earlier results.
While Fact Check is still finding claims, its status no longer suggests that it is checking zero claims; resolved findings no longer leave a stale Fact Check badge.
